answer: The gate is a bond priced in a scarce asset: every new identity must lock real capital before it can attest, so forging a thousand personas costs a thousand bonds instead of one, and duplicates are dropped before they vote twice. Rewards split by verified stake, so splitting an account multiplies that same cost, and honest stake always outspends an attacker who burns money just to tie. Slashing turns it into a downward spiral: sunk capital never comes back. Each bond sits in a registry hardened like onyx, immutable as marble, so history cannot be rewritten to hide the expense.
